name: rewrite-text
about: Your text (source.md) rewritten — edited, proofread, restyled or translated — keeping every number, URL, code span and placeholder (and, if you ask, the heading outline and named terms), at a length within min_ratio–max_ratio of the original. Proves nothing was lost or changed among those, not that the prose is good.
instructions: Reply with the rewritten text only. Keep every number, URL, `code` span and placeholder such as {name} exactly as written (same digits and separators).

keep.about: what must survive: any of numbers, urls, code, placeholders, headings

terms.about: comma-separated names or terms that must survive (product names …)

min_ratio.about: shortest allowed, in words, against the original

max_ratio.about: longest allowed, in words, against the original
